Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Rajesh Menon. I am a 25-year-old civil engineer living in Jaipur. Ishita Jadhav gave me a cheque for ₹38,00,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. My case number is CC/990/2025 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Jaipur. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 96584 28569 or email rajesh.menon@example.in.
